title: CEYO Transparency Log Inclusion Proof
description: A Merkle sibling-path proof that a CEYO artifact subject was included in the tree represented by a declared root/tree size. The reference transparency profile uses RFC 8785 canonicalization. For protocol v2 the artifact subject is RFC8785({protected, integrity}), excluding appendable receipts; legacy v1 uses its historical full-envelope subject when newly entered into this reference log.

artifact_id.description: Artifact identifier associated with the logged subject. For v2 it originates from signed protected.artifact_id.

artifact_hash.description: Base64url-encoded SHA-256 digest of the reference-log subject. V2: SHA-256(RFC8785({protected, integrity})); v1: SHA-256(RFC8785(full_envelope)) for new reference-log entries. This digest is domain-separated to form the Merkle leaf.

leaf_index.description: Zero-based position of the leaf in the represented tree.

tree_size.description: Number of leaves in the tree state against which this proof was generated.

root_hash.description: Base64url-encoded SHA-256 Merkle root that the sibling path reconstructs.

hashes.description: Ordered sibling path from the artifact leaf toward the root.
